# viettelidc_ovpc_backup_scheduler (Resource)

ViettelIDC Backup Scheduler — a recurring backup of whole VMs. Distinct from `viettelidc_ovpc_backup_plan`, which schedules volume backups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# VM-level backup schedule.
# vm_ids are the backup service's VM UUIDs, which are not the numeric instance
# ids: list them with GET /backup/api/v1/vpc/{vpc_id}/vms/all.
resource "viettelidc_ovpc_backup_scheduler" "daily" {
  name             = "daily-vm-backup"
  description      = "Every day at 04:00"
  cycle            = "DAILY"
  start_date       = "2026-09-01"
  start_time       = "04:00:00"
  number_of_record = 7

  vm_ids = [
    "78ec434d-8cc0-45c8-9bb6-8c3435a7f567",
  ]

  # Destroying the schedule keeps the backup records unless this is true.
  delete_records_on_destroy = false

  vpc_id = data.viettelidc_ovpc_vpc.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cycle` (String) How often the backup runs, e.g. "DAILY".
- `name` (String) Schedule name.
- `number_of_record` (Number) How many backup records to retain.
- `start_date` (String) Date of the first run, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `start_time` (String) Time of day to run, HH:MM:SS.
- `vm_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the VMs to back up. Changing the set adds or removes members in place; it does not replace the schedule.

### Optional

- `delete_records_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether destroying the schedule also deletes the backup records it produced.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID. Falls back to the provider default vpc_id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Backup schedule UUID.
- `next_time` (String) When the schedule next runs.
- `status` (String) Current schedule status.
